items.source: When in effect, the auto-configuration is the equivalent of enabling Spring Data's web support through the @EnableSpringDataWebSupport annotation.
items.translation: 生效时，自动配置等同于通过 @EnableSpringDataWebSupport 注解启用 Spring Data 的 Web 支持。

items.source: Andy Wilkinson, Vedran Pavic, Yanming Zhou
